purpose: Manual or model-reviewed forward cases. CI verifies that each rubric remains anchored to the shipped skill instructions; it does not claim to execute an agent.
review_protocol: Use a fresh model session that has not seen the implementation discussion.
For activation cases, provide only the user prompt and the SKILL.md frontmatter description, then judge whether managing-skills should activate.
For reporting cases, load SKILL.md and references/reporting.md, provide the scenario evidence, and ask the model to draft the user-facing result.
Record pass or fail against every stated expectation and include the model output for human review.

activation.prompt: Manage my skills and show me which installed copies are outdated.
Help me manage agent skills shared across Codex and Claude.
activation.instruction_anchor: clearly asks for help managing their agent skills

activation.prompt: Use $managing-skills to preview updates to my installed skills.
Install the package described in this repository.
activation.instruction_anchor: without framing it as skill management

activation.prompt: Inspect the reviewing-my-code instructions and summarize them.
activation.instruction_anchor: independently ask to install, inspect, update, or remove something

activation.prompt: Update the README for the managing-skills skill.

reporting.prompt: Manage my skills and show the installed copies of reviewing-my-code.
evidence: the two source names are needed to explain the version difference
guidance_anchors: Lead with the outcome or answer, then the evidence needed to act on it.
Use labeled fields for one item and a compact table for two or more comparable items or significant destinations.
pass_if: uses a compact comparison and retains source provenance
fail_if: adds empty columns or irrelevant paths

reporting.prompt: Manage my skills: preview loading reviewing-my-code globally, but do not apply it.
evidence: shared global target would receive one new deployment with six files
the command was a dry run and made no changes
guidance_anchors: Before any operation requiring confirmation, present one complete plan.
distinguish dry-run from committed work explicitly.
pass_if: states that this is a preview and no changes were made
surfaces source, skill, target, scope, and significant change together
fail_if: dumps raw NDJSON or terminal decoration

reporting.prompt: Manage my skills and tell me what happened when the approved load completed.
evidence: reviewing-my-code loaded to the shared global target
a warning says the Claude destination was disabled
one deployment changed and one was unchanged
guidance_anchors: Name each changed item and its action.
Surface warnings next to the affected item or decision.
End with a significance-gated summary containing only nonzero outcomes.
pass_if: names the loaded skill and places the disabled-destination warning beside its impact
omits the unchanged item unless it materially explains selection or blast radius

reporting.prompt: Manage my skills and explain this failed multi-target update.
evidence: the Claude write then failed with: access denied
guidance_anchors: If the process fails after actions, report committed actions first, then the exact failure and what remains incomplete.
pass_if: reports the committed Codex action before the exact access denied failure
identifies the Claude work as incomplete
fail_if: claims or implies that the Codex action rolled back
